name: coasterrank
description: Meta-package: convenience runners for the app/, scripts/, and packages/bt/ sub-packages. No workspaces — each sub-package keeps its own dependencies and lockfile.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix scripts install && npm --prefix packages/bt install
scripts.gates: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix app run test:run && npm --prefix app run format:check
scripts.gates:all: npm run gates && npm --prefix scripts run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/bt run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/bt test
